mapper.select: select ee.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodId, ee.PS as ps, ee.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, ee.PRICE as price, ee.ENTRUST_NUM as entrustNum, ee.VDATE as vdate, ee.MDATE as mdate, ee.ENTRUST_AMT as entrustAmt, eea.SEC_ACCT_ID from ETR_ENTRUST ee inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea on ee.ENTRUST_ID = eea.ENTRUST_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID where ee.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
